info.name: OpenAI Assistants Project group role assignments API
Lists the project roles assigned to a group within a project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The ID of the project to inspect.

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the group to inspect.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of project role assignments to return.

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the value from the previous response's `next` field to continue listing project roles.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for the returned project roles.

items.docs: Lists the project roles assigned to a group within a project.

info.name: Assigns a project role to a group within a project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The ID of the project to update.

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the group that should receive the project role.

info.name: Unassigns a project role from a group within a project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The ID of the project to modify.

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the group whose project role assignment should be removed.

params.name: role_id
params.description: The ID of the project role to remove from the group.
